credit: The Lazy Lord Masters the Sword (Dodomoon / Doip / Second Star)
title: Airen throws away the whole exam to haul a drowning girl out of the lake . . . (highlight)

segments.say: Airen throws away the whole exam to haul a drowning girl out of the *lake*.
Then Airen lifts the big sword and drops a vertical slash, and the blades *clash*.
Lloyd's blade stops at his throat, and the duel is *over*. Still, a month with a sword is wild.
Then the classes are read out. Illia, Lloyd and Judith all land in Class A, and Airen lands in Class *F*.
Judith rants about that arrogant Lloyd, then blushes, panics, and *punches* Airen. Classic tsundere.
That night Lloyd can't sleep, because he keeps replaying that vertical *slash*.
In Class F, Ron Tarhall asks Airen what he is missing. Airen says effort, but Ron says it's *talent*.
Then Ron makes a bet. Master the basic sword skills in a week, and Airen moves up to Class *C*.
So Airen swings all day, every day, until even Ron admits he never improved this *fast*.
On the last day Judith watches his swing and gives him a thumbs up, and Airen is *promoted* to Class C.
At lunch Judith inhales a mountain of food, and Lloyd's friends call her a hippo. She asks the loudest guy if he has a *crush*.
Judith asks if Airen and Illia had a fight. Illia is still number one, and rumor says she trains alone every *night*.
So Judith spars with him, and Airen eats her storm of attacks. Then he throws his vertical slash, and her eyes *pop*.
She grins that he's improved, but he's not at her level *yet*. And it's dark, so Illia is probably training *alone*.
The full story is on our channel.
